verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API docs say users can programmatically manage API keys, so the product can issue credentials an agent could use. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped to specific permissions, datasets or environments for least-privilege use. Missing for 10: documented per-key permission scopes, least-privilege or read-only key options for agents or MCP, environment/dataset-level restriction, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
